semantically_equivalent_models.justification: The term 'gpt-family models' refers to all models that are based on the same underlying architecture as the original GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) models. 'gpt-xl' is a term often used for a specific size of a GPT-family model. Therefore, it is semantically equivalent in the context of representing members of the GPT family.

parent_models.justification: The 'gpt-family models' is a broad category that encompasses all variations and sizes of models built on the GPT architecture. 'gpt-xl' is a larger version within this family, representing a specific instance of such a parent model.
'gpt-j' is considered a variant within the family of GPT models, thus acting as a parent to specific sub-variants or instances that adhere to its particular architectural specifications.
'gpt-neo' is part of the GPT-family lineage and serves as a parent to models like 'gpt-neox', as both share architectural inspirations from the broader GPT model family.
Similarly, 'gpt-3.5' is an iteration within the GPT series that could function as a parent model when thought of in relation to specific implementations or further refinements thereof.

It directly aligns with the description of 'gpt-family models' due to having characteristics indicative of a larger model within the same lineage.
